# corpus-clean-large-utf8 - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the reviewer reading a plan with a large UTF-8 appendix.
**Outcome:** size, CRLF and emoji never change the structural verdict.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；1 个实施 todo + F1；大文件由 builder 物化。

## Scope
### Affected user and ideal state
| Row | Statement | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 大体积 UTF-8 计划仍被正确预检。 | builder 生成。 |
| GAP-1 | 缺少大文件语料。 | 1 关闭。 |

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

- [ ] 1. 校验大体积 UTF-8 计划
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 读取 `docs/fidelity.md`；确认 builder 输出至少 100 KiB；不提交大副本。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: F1
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: builder 输出字节数不低于 102400。
  QA scenarios: Happy “large-utf8-builds” 三次构建字节一致。Failure “large-utf8-differs” 任意两次构建不同即失败。
  Commit: Y | test(corpus): large utf8 case

以下为 builder 生成的大体积 UTF-8 附录（fence 内是数据，不是行）：

```text
%%REPEAT%%
%%LONG%%
```

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

- [ ] F1. Plan compliance audit
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit
  What to do / Must NOT do: 只读核对每个 todo 与证据；不修改任何文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 2 | Blocked by: 1 | Blocks: —
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 每项都有证据。
  QA scenarios: Happy “audit-passes” 逐项对照证据。Failure “no-evidence” 缺证据即拒绝。
  Commit: N | 审计不单独提交

## Commit strategy
- 每个 N 项与测试一起提交。

## Success criteria
| IS | Delivering todo(s) | Proving QA scenario | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 1,F1 | large-utf8-builds | `$E/task-1.txt` |
